name: streaming
description: Self-hosted multi-platform live chat control room: TikTok, Twitch and YouTube in one event stream, with filters, text-to-speech, browser-source overlays and a desktop chat panel.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @streaming/shared && npm run build -w @streaming/overlay && npm run build -w @streaming/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @streaming/shared && npm run typecheck -w @streaming/server && npm run typecheck -w @streaming/overlay
scripts.test:live: npm run check:api -w @streaming/server && npm run check:penalty -w @streaming/server && npm run check:listeners -w @streaming/server
